paragraphs.text: The Forward Order was a holy order of clerics devoted to the healing arts, based in the Caligo Forest , a bleak backwater of uncertain location on Benalia .
Members of the order included Lady Ana and her apprentice Liliana Vess , but their branch of the order was wiped out in the fall of House Vess.
